page_title: AI Prompt Generator: Free, No Sign-up

sources.entry: Prompt Generator - Writes prompts in the syntax of the AI tool you pick (ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, Midjourney, Nano Banana, Veo, Sora and more), with 10 free prompts a day and no sign-up. #freemium #writing

summary.name: AI Prompt Generator
summary.one_liner: A web tool that turns a rough idea into a complete prompt formatted for a specific AI tool such as ChatGPT, Claude, Midjourney, Nano Banana or Veo.
keywords: camera and lens cues for video ai
use_cases: Writing a ChatGPT or Claude prompt from a rough idea
Creating Midjourney or Stable Diffusion image prompts
Drafting Veo or Sora video prompts with camera cues
Generating a prompt from an existing picture
Shortening or expanding an existing prompt
summary.what_it_does: The tool takes a rough sentence describing what you want and produces a full prompt for the AI tool you choose. It covers 6 chat targets, 6 image models and 5 video models, with output in each tool's syntax, such as comma phrases and --ar for Midjourney, weighted tags and a negative prompt for Stable Diffusion, XML-tagged sections for Claude, and camera, lens and audio cues for Veo. Users can set tone, length, aspect ratio or camera under Options, and can make a result shorter or more detailed in one click. Output can be copied, opened in ChatGPT or Claude, or run as image and video prompts in the studio. An Image to Prompt feature starts from a picture.
notable: Output follows each target tool's prompt syntax (e.g. Midjourney --ar, Claude XML tags, Veo camera cues)
Covers text, image and video AI tools in one place
Image to Prompt starts from a picture
No account needed for 10 free prompts a day
caveats: Free use is limited to 10 prompts a day
Running image and video prompts in the studio is implied to be a separate step; its terms are not described on the page
Pricing beyond the free daily limit is not stated in the page text
